description: Implement session registration UI for members in sessions.js. Add 'Đăng ký lớp' button that opens modal listing available schedules (GET /api/Schedule with future dates). Member selects schedule and clicks 'Tham Gia' to POST /api/Session with { scheduleId, memberId, registrationDate: today, status: 'Registered' }. In member session list, show status badges: 'Registered' = yellow (chờ duyệt), 'Attended' = green (đã duyệt), 'Cancelled' = red. Member can cancel own registration if status is 'Registered'.
steps: Read wwwroot/js/sessions.js renderMemberSessions() around line 120 - note the 'Đăng ký lớp' button placeholder at line 128 calls showRegisterSessionModal() which is unimplemented (line 483)

Read Controllers/SessionController.cs to understand: POST /api/Session body is { scheduleId, memberId, registrationDate, status }, GET /api/Schedule returns schedules with className, trainerName, startTime, endTime
Implement showRegisterSessionModal(): fetch schedules (future only - filter startTime > now), display in modal table with columns: Lớp, HLV, Thời gian, Tham Gia button
On 'Tham Gia' click: POST /api/Session with { scheduleId, memberId: getMemberId(), registrationDate: new Date().toISOString(), status: 'Registered' }
Show success toast, close modal, reload member session list
In renderMemberSessionsTable() (line 145), adjust status badge logic: 'Registered' -> badge-warning (yellow), 'Attended' -> badge-success (green), 'Cancelled' -> badge-danger (red)

Add cancel button to each 'Registered' session: onclick calls DELETE /api/Session/{sessionId} or updates status to 'Cancelled' via PUT /api/Session/{id}/status with { status: 'Cancelled' } (check controller - it has PUT {id}/status endpoint)
acceptance_criteria: Member can click 'Đăng ký lớp' button and see modal with available future schedules
Clicking 'Tham Gia' creates session with status 'Registered'
Member session list shows color-coded badges: yellow for Registered, green for Attended, red for Cancelled
Member can cancel own Registered sessions (status changes to Cancelled)
Cannot cancel Attended sessions (no button shown)
verification: Click 'Đăng ký lớp' button - verify modal opens with schedule list
Click 'Tham Gia' on a schedule - verify success toast
Verify new session appears in list with yellow 'Registered' badge
Click cancel button on registered session - verify status changes to red 'Cancelled'
Verify attended sessions (if any) show green badge with no cancel button
